---
id: env.excl.fines-and-penalties
type: exclusion
heading: Fines and Penalties
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Any fine, penalty, punitive, exemplary or aggravated damages, or civil pecuniary penalty, including a penalty under environmental law. This exclusion does not apply to clean-up costs or natural resource damage that environmental law requires you to pay, even where the same law also imposes a penalty.

We do not pay any amount that the law does not allow to be insured. [WP REVIEW: confirm, state by state, that clean-up costs recoverable by an environment protection authority (for example under a NSW clean-up notice or a Victorian environmental action notice) are compensatory and insurable, as distinct from penalties.]
